response.overview: Erika, a young archaeologist, refuses to accept the sale of the last column of the Temple of Hera Lacinia to a foreign buyer.  In a landscape marked by neglect and silence, and with the help of a plan inherited from her father — a former tomb raider — she decides to carry out a bold and poetic act: to steal the column, a symbol of resistance and the defense of her identity.
response.title: The Column
